iteration.description: One closed round of the assessment. It holds what you decided, and a hash that links it to the round before.

by.description: Who finalized it. This is the list of assessors in project.yaml, unless you gave -by.

date.description: The date and time it was finalized, as RFC 3339 with the time zone, such as 2026-10-18T14:32:07+02:00.

decisions.description: Your decision for every risk, by the id of its threat scenario. It holds the treatment, the base and residual values, and a short digest of the rationale and the reference.

inputs.description: A fingerprint of the project files the decisions were made from. These are the configuration, the project file, the policy and the records. assess finalize uses it to see whether anything changed since.

note.description: What this iteration was, in a sentence.

number.description: The number of the iteration. Numbers start at 1 and have no gap.

previous.description: The hash of the iteration before it. The first iteration has none.

signatures.description: Signatures of the hash, added by assess sign.

tool.description: The version of assess that finalized it.

iterations.description: The closed iterations of the assessment. assess finalize adds an iteration when the decisions of a round are complete, and assess sign adds signatures to it. Each iteration holds the hash of the one before it, so assess verify can find a change. Do not edit this file by hand.
The closed iterations, oldest first. assess finalize writes them. Do not edit them. Each one holds the hash of the one before it, so assess verify can find a change.

signature.description: A signature of the hash of an iteration, made with a private key that only the signer holds.

key.description: The fingerprint of the public key that checks the signature.

description: The file iterations.yaml of an assess project. assess schema writes this file. Do not edit it.
title: iterations.yaml
